narrative.northStar: Capital in focus. Proof within reach.
narrative.overview: A serious finance workspace organized around evidence, recorded judgment, review and a durable receipt. Warm canvas, white working panels, dark project context and selective chartreuse connect inspection with the investor and builder experience without turning the queue into an investment dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-first working density, not dashboard theater.
Labeled financial context without decorative capital totals.
Explicit identity, evidence version and signing consequence.

rules.name: The Brand Is Not Outcome Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse is not success. Passed, held, failed and pending states always carry words and distinct semantic treatment.

rules.name: The Labeled Amount Rule
rules.body: Every prominent amount names what it measures. Project amount and milestone amount are not balances available to withdraw.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Effects Rule
rules.body: Motion clarifies real state changes; it never simulates verification or financial completion.

rules.name: The Signature Is Not Release Rule
rules.body: An inspector signs a judgment. The platform release service evaluates the milestone suite separately; audit submitted, checks passed, release pending and funds released are distinct states.

dos: Do keep task count and credentials above the queue, without capital totals.
Do label amounts, retain RLUSD units and preserve domain precision.
Do show full uncropped evidence with provenance and original-file access.
Do preserve review/back, evidence-version checks, signing guards and durable receipts.
Do prioritize 1280×720 projector and 1440×900 desktop acceptance.
Do reconcile this token snapshot with shared CSS after concurrent work settles.
donts: Don't restore blue-primary actions or the stale white-everywhere direction.
Don't invent metrics, site photographs, release claims or Devnet connectivity.
Don't use chartreuse as success, white text on chartreuse, or light-surface muted text on dark context.
Don't replace history rows with repeated check-card grids or crop inspection photographs.
Don't add gradients, glass, neon, fake checks or financial-completion theater.
Don't weaken validation, stale-evidence, signing-key, identity or duplicate-submit protections.
